name: Ca thu mot nang
summary: Mackerel dried under one day’s sun and packed to take home. Like the one-sun squid, it holds an OCOP three-star rating.
origin: Côn Đảo. Báo Đồng Nai, 11 July 2025, and VOV, 6 May 2025.
culture: VOV says Cá thu một nắng Côn Đảo received a trademark in 2020 and an OCOP three-star certificate in 2024.
howToEat: Take it home as a pack.
where: Chợ Côn Đảo, the daily market in town.
seoTitle: Ca thu mot nang — one-sun mackerel in Con Dao
seoDescription: Cá thu một nắng is mackerel dried under one day’s sun, an OCOP three-star pack from Côn Đảo.
